question: Should assistant-message plain-text copy be implemented as a compact Markdown/plain-text copy menu, a persisted default-copy-format preference, or declined for now?
rationale: The implementation is probably small, but the visible UX and conversion contract affect clipboard output, i18n, optional settings surface, and hidden/rendered message semantics.

options.title: Copy Menu
options.body: Add a compact menu or split action with Copy as Markdown and Copy as Plain Text, leaving any default-format preference for later.

options.title: Persisted Preference
options.body: Add a default copy-format preference and keep the message copy button as one action, accepting extra settings and i18n surface.

options.title: Decline Core Change
options.body: Keep Markdown-only copy behavior if maintainers decide plain-text clipboard formatting is not worth the Control UI surface.

recommendation.title: Copy Menu
recommendation.body: Add a compact menu or split action with Copy as Markdown and Copy as Plain Text, leaving any default-format preference for later.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the original copy-as-markdown behavior and is the strongest history-backed routing candidate for this UX decision.
